text.arabic_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening connector that resumes the argument and links the prior verdict to the created-order proof
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a discourse bridge rather than a loose additive. It leaves the exact relation broad, but its position makes the creation clause answer the prior bad judgment by moving immediately into a proof from ordered reality.

topics.headline: opening bridge into proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not start a detached cosmological note; it resumes the prior verdict by turning creation into evidence.
topics.reason: QAC and clause evidence identify the word as an opening connector before the creation assertion, while the CRITICAL rows tie that opening to the prior moral verdict.

words.gloss_range: perfect active creation verb governing the heavens-earth pair as the established basis for later recompense
words.root_gloss_range: forming, creating, measuring, and proportioning; locally selected as direct real creation of the cosmic pair, not fabricated invention or intensive repeated shaping
words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}) launches the proof with a completed active act before the named subject appears. The {{ar:خ ل ق}} ({{tr:kh-l-q}}) field contributes measured making, so the created heavens-earth frame is not bare origination but proportioned order ready to bear recompense. The actual Form I keeps the act direct and real; the not-play creation parallels in 38:27, 44:38-39, and 6:73 sharpen the same point, while the hard opening sound gives the proof a compact landing.

topics.headline: completed active creation basis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees recompense resting on an already established creative act rather than on an undefined future arrangement.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect active, begins the clause, and takes the following named subject and objects in the creation assertion.

topics.headline: measured forming without fabrication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that creation is presented as measured real formation, while the local Form I blocks fabricated-making or intensive-craft overreadings.
topics.reason: The root range supports forming and proportioning, but the local Form I and cosmic objects narrow the active branch to direct real creation.

topics.headline: creation scene specialized toward judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the familiar creation-of-heavens-and-earth scene turned toward individual recompense, with 38:27, 44:38-39, and 6:73 as creation-by-right contrasts.
topics.reason: The row family connects this creation root to the heavens-earth merism and to cross-passage creation statements that deny play or arbitrariness.

topics.headline: verb-first proof shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the proof begin with action and decisive sound before the clause expands into agent, cosmos, truth, and recompense.
topics.reason: The verb stands first in the creation clause and the CRITICAL rows note both its clause-framing placement and compact phonetic impact.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in nominative post-verbal subject position, naming the creator before passive recompense clauses
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field associated with worship, dependence, and disputed derivational background; locally the proper name fixes personal divine agency
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:llāhu}}) names the agent after the creation verb and before the cosmic objects. The proper name keeps creation, truth, recompense, and no-wronging from becoming an anonymous mechanism. The {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) derivational background remains useful only as pressure around divine identity; locally the proper name governs. Its explicit appearance also frames the later passives, where agency is suppressed but not detached from the named creator. Within the same thread, the name that marked exclusive protection in 45:19 and creation power in 14:19 now frames recompense justice.

topics.headline: named creator agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the order of creation and recompense is personal divine agency, not impersonal cosmic law.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative post-verbal subject of the creation verb and is identified as the proper divine name.

topics.headline: proper name over derivational pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the worship and dependence field in view while letting the local proper name, not derivational speculation, carry the subject slot.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is real background, but QAC identifies the local form as a proper noun and the syntax makes it the named subject.

topics.headline: named agency before passive justice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the later passive settlement clauses can omit an agent without becoming agentless in meaning.
topics.reason: The named creator stands before passive recompense and passive no-wronging clauses, so the ayah can foreground order and recipients after agency is established.

topics.headline: same-surah divine thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect 45:22 with 45:19 and 14:19 as divine agency moves from protection and creation power into recompense justice.
topics.reason: The rows supply same-surah and cross-passage links where the same divine name frames protection, creation, and judgment.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine plural direct object naming the recognized layered upper domain in the created totality
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, rising, and upperness; locally selected as the plural heavens in the heavens-earth merism
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) is the first direct object of creation, so the upper realms are not scenery but made order. The {{ar:س م و}} ({{tr:s-m-w}}) height field makes the proof begin from elevated plurality, while the local merism selects the heavens sense over a marking alternative. Its plural scale widens the frame before earth and finally every self brings the argument down to accountable life; the related scale in 2:29 and this surah's recurring cosmic frame keep the heavens-earth pair recognizable. The assimilated article also makes the definite plural sound cohere before the pivot to earth.

topics.headline: plural created upper object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heavens as a known layered object of creation, not a decorative setting beside the proof.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word the first direct object of the creation verb; its definite plural form supplies the layered upper domain.

topics.headline: elevation selected over marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the vertical movement from upper created height toward each accountable self, while the local heavens-earth pair keeps the marking alternative from governing the sense.
topics.reason: The root dispute is valid background, but the local plural heavens form and paired earth object select the elevation branch.

topics.headline: heavens-earth totality begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense is placed inside a total created order, with 2:29 offering a related heavens-earth scale.
topics.reason: The word begins the strongly attested heavens-earth merism, and the local coordination with earth completes the totality before recompense.

topics.headline: same-surah cosmic frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this plural heavens term as part of the surah's repeated cosmic frame, with its sound and recurrence holding the pair together.
topics.reason: The row family connects the word to same-surah recurrence and to audible pair cohesion before the earth term.

words.gloss_range: object-linking connector that joins earth to the heavens under one creation verb and completes the merism
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the small hinge that keeps earth under the same act of creation as the heavens. Grammatically it coordinates a second object; rhetorically it completes the totality pair, so the later accounting rests on created order as a whole rather than on one domain.

topics.headline: connector completing cosmic merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle does more than add an item; it binds the two created domains into one proof-set.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates earth with the heavens as the second object of the same creation verb, completing the meristic totality.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth as coordinated direct object and lower created arena
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, earth, and lower realm; locally the single earth completes the heavens-earth totality and becomes the action-ground for earning
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍa}}) completes the created pair as the second direct object, so the human arena is deliberately made under the same verb. The {{ar:أ ر ض}} ({{tr:ʾ-r-ḍ}}) ground-field turns the cosmic proof toward embodied acquisition: the argument descends from plural heights to the single arena where earning can be attributed. The not-play contrast in 44:38-39 helps show why this created ground is not morally neutral scenery.

topics.headline: singular created ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees earth as the known single lower arena deliberately created with the heavens, not a secondary setting.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the word as a direct object of the creation verb, and its definite singular form contracts the cosmic scale.

topics.headline: earth as action-ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the created ground becomes the arena where earning is attributable, joining cosmology to moral agency.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the ground-field of earth to the later self and earning language, and the local clause sequence supports that movement.

topics.headline: merism closed before truth phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees truth modify a complete heavens-earth totality, not just one half of creation.
topics.reason: The earth term completes the paired object before the truth prepositional phrase enters.

topics.headline: not-play creation lands on accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect 44:38-39 with this ayah: creation not made in play becomes the ground where acts are earned and judged.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly supply the 44:38-39 not-play parallel and link earth to the later self and earning terms.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition binding truth/right to the creation clause as mode, means, accompaniment, or ground
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the truth phrase grammatically dependent but semantically controlling. Its range lets creation be read as by truth, in truth, and on the ground of right at once, and its bound form fuses that basis to the creation clause before the purpose-result hinge appears.

topics.headline: preposition of truth basis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth is not an afterthought; the preposition makes it the governing mode and basis of creation before recompense is introduced.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence ties the preposition to the truth complement modifying creation, while the CRITICAL rows preserve its mode, means, accompaniment, and grounding range.

words.gloss_range: definite truth/right/reality as genitive complement of the preposition and modal basis of creation
words.root_gloss_range: established truth, reality, right, justice, due claim, and fixed validity; locally the governing basis by which creation supports recompense
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) names creation's established basis as definite truth, right, and reality. The {{ar:ح ق ق}} ({{tr:ḥ-q-q}}) range fuses ontology and justice, so recompense is not bolted onto the cosmos but follows from rightful order. Its hinge position turns the created pair toward accounting, while 44:39, 6:73, and 45:29 keep truth-bound creation and truthful record-speech in view. The word also answers the prior defective human judgment by moving to reality already constituted in right, and it opens the moral bookend that the final no-wronging clause will close.

topics.headline: definite established right
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees creation grounded in known established right, not merely described as factually true.
topics.reason: The word is the definite genitive complement of the preposition and the CRITICAL rows support an established truth, right, and reality range.

topics.headline: ontology fused with due right
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reality and justice are joined in one noun before the ayah states recompense by earnings.
topics.reason: The lexical range covers truth, reality, right, and due claim, and the local closure supplies the wronging opposite.

topics.headline: truth-bound creation parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 44:39 and 6:73, where creation by truth denies play or arbitrariness, with this ayah's move into recompense.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly cite creation-by-truth parallels and show this ayah specifying their payoff as individual recompense.

topics.headline: hinge into accounting and bookend
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows a visible architecture: truth grounds creation, earned content grounds recompense, and negated wronging protects the proportional result.
topics.reason: The word stands between the cosmic objects and the recompense purpose clause, and the CRITICAL rows tie it to the later earned-basis and no-wronging closure.

topics.headline: same-surah truth thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect 45:22 with 45:29, where truth also governs judgment evidence, and with the prior defective human judgment.
topics.reason: The rows provide the same-surah recurrence at 45:29 and the boundary move from prior bad judgment into established right.

words.gloss_range: connector before the purpose particle, pivoting from creation by truth into recompense
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots the ayah from created fact into moral consequence while keeping both movements coordinated. It prevents the recompense phrase from floating as a separate maxim; the same argument that names creation by truth now moves into settlement for every self.

topics.headline: pivot into recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accounting is not appended to creation; it is coordinated as the next movement of the same proof.
topics.reason: The particle stands before the purpose lām and links the recompense clause back to the creation statement.

words.gloss_range: purpose-result particle governing the passive recompense verb and binding accounting to creation by truth
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes the recompense verb dependent on the creation clause. Its purpose-result range is productive here: creation is oriented toward settlement, and truth-bound creation issues in each self receiving its due. The bound particle makes that direction visible before the recompensed subject is even named.

topics.headline: purpose-result binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees recompense as structurally purposed by creation, not as an unrelated future event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the particle govern the passive recompense verb, and the CRITICAL rows preserve both purpose and outcome force.

words.gloss_range: lām-governed passive recompense verb foregrounding the settlement event and the recompensed self
words.root_gloss_range: recompense, compensation, return, repayment, and sufficiency; locally a passive settlement whose direction is determined by what the self earned
words.prose: {{ar:تُجْزَىٰ}} ({{tr:tujzā}}) brings the purpose-result clause into the settlement event while suppressing the agent already framed by the named creator. The {{ar:ج ز ي}} ({{tr:j-z-y}}) range covers reward and penalty, so the verb waits for the earned basis to decide the direction of return. Its feminine agreement with the self is local, though the accepted variant shifts focus toward default event-framing. The formula in 40:17 and the same-surah sequence at 45:14 and 45:28 show the accounting pattern now grounded in cosmic creation. Across the ayah's voice contrast, active creation gives way to passive settlement and passive protection, shifting attention from named agency to just outcome.

topics.headline: passive settlement event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb foregrounds the recompensed self and settlement event after divine agency has already been named.
topics.reason: The verb is passive, governed by the preceding purpose particle, and followed by the universal self phrase as its passive subject.

topics.headline: two-sided settlement range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verb can cover reward or penalty, making the earned basis essential rather than decorative.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports recompense in both directions, and the following basis phrase supplies what determines the return.

topics.headline: variant shifts agreement focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical form tracks feminine agreement with the self, while the variant keeps the same accounting logic with more event-centered framing.
topics.reason: The variant is useful for contrast, but the local canonical form remains the feminine passive agreeing with the self phrase.

topics.headline: accounting formula in creation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 40:17 and 45:14, where recompense and earning recur, with 45:22's cosmic preface.
topics.reason: The rows identify recurring accounting formulas and same-surah recompense language that this ayah universalizes.

topics.headline: voice contrast in justice sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees active creation followed by passive settlement and protection, shifting attention from agency to just outcome.
topics.reason: The ayah names the active creator first, then uses passives for recompense and no-wronging to foreground recipients and outcomes.

words.gloss_range: construct-head universal quantifier functioning with the following self as the passive subject of recompense
words.root_gloss_range: every, each, all, totality, and completeness; locally exhaustive eachness distributed through a singular self, not an undifferentiated mass
words.prose: {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) puts universality into the passive subject slot before the self is named. The {{ar:ك ل ل}} ({{tr:k-l-l}}) totality field is locally distributed through a singular complement, so the ayah excludes exceptions without turning persons into a mass. This every-self formula resonates with 21:47 and 40:17, then is answered later by the plural protected group.

topics.headline: universal passive subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every self is made grammatically central to recompense before any earned basis is stated.
topics.reason: The quantifier heads the construct phrase that functions as the passive subject of the recompense verb.

topics.headline: eachness without collectivism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exhaustive inclusion working one self at a time, not as a vague collective total.
topics.reason: The lexical force is each and every, and the construct with a singular self distributes that totality individually.

topics.headline: every-self accounting formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 21:47 and 40:17, where universal self-accounting is tied to justice and no wronging.
topics.reason: The rows identify the recurring every-self accountability formula and its justice parallels.

topics.headline: individual assessment to plural protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the movement from each individually assessed self to the final plural guarantee of non-wronging.
topics.reason: The word precedes the singular self, and the final pronoun later gathers the distributive singulars into a plural protected group.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular self in construct with every, controlling the feminine recompense and earning agreement
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, person, life, breath, and living moral subject; locally the accountable individual self
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسٍۭ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) is singular and indefinite under universality, so accountability is distributed one living self at a time. The {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) field brings personhood and life into the accounting frame, not just a detached list of acts. Its feminine agreement links the recompense verb and the earning verb to the same subject, while 2:286 and the final plural pronoun keep individual liability tied to collective protection.

topics.headline: indefinite distributive self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universal judgment is distributed through each possible self rather than applied to humanity as a lump sum.
topics.reason: The word is the genitive singular complement of the universal construct and remains indefinite inside that distribution.

topics.headline: agreement locks same subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recompensed subject and earning subject locked to the same self before the final group assurance expands the view.
topics.reason: The feminine agreement of the recompense and earning verbs points back to this self, while the final pronoun later gathers those selves.

topics.headline: living moral subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense reaches the living moral person, not merely an abstract record.
topics.reason: The root range includes self, life, and personhood, and the local recompense and earning frame selects the morally accountable self.

topics.headline: self earning within cosmic scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 2:286 while seeing the ayah contract from cosmos to one self and then expand to the protected group.
topics.reason: The rows tie self and earning to 2:286 and identify the local scale movement from cosmic merism to distributive self to plural protection.

words.gloss_range: second prefixed preposition marking the basis, exchange, or measure of recompense
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) opens the evidentiary basis phrase after the self has been named. Its range as basis, exchange, and measure ties recompense to what was earned rather than to arbitrary decree. As the second such prepositional hinge, it mirrors the earlier truth-basis phrase: creation has a principled basis, and judgment has an earned basis. The bound particle and following nasal m make the basis phrase sound like one unit waiting for the earning verb to complete it.

topics.headline: earned basis of recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the return is measured by earned evidence, not left unspecified.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition govern the relative pronoun as the basis of recompense, and the rows preserve basis, exchange, and measure.

topics.headline: twin basis echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's proportional structure: truth grounds creation and earned content grounds judgment.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows explicitly pair the first truth-basis preposition with this earned-basis preposition.

topics.headline: sound-bound basis unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the basis phrase as one unit that waits for the earning verb to complete it.
topics.reason: The particle is bound to the following relative pronoun and the row notes the phonetic bridge into the earning phrase.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun after the basis preposition, left open until the earning verb supplies its content
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the basis of recompense open until the earning verb fills it. As a relative pronoun it points to whatever was earned, and its maṣdar-like pressure can lean toward the earning itself; both readings broaden the evidentiary field without loosening attribution. The open pronoun answers the definite truth basis by letting fixed created order measure whatever the self actually acquired.

topics.headline: open relative basis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence is not listed in advance; the basis remains open until the self's acquired content is supplied.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a relative pronoun governed by the preposition, and the earning verb completes its content.

topics.headline: relative and process pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the accountable basis include both what was earned and, by pressure, the earning process, while the local relative clause still supplies attribution.
topics.reason: The surface allows relative and maṣdar-like pressure, but attachment evidence keeps the local structure as a relative basis completed by the earning verb.

topics.headline: open basis answers fixed truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fixed created truth measuring an open range of actual acquisitions rather than a preselected list of deeds.
topics.reason: The rows contrast the earlier definite truth basis with this open relative basis that the earning verb resolves.

words.gloss_range: perfect feminine earning/acquisition verb completing the relative basis and agreeing with the singular self
words.root_gloss_range: earning, acquiring, gaining, making one's own, and incurring liability; locally the acquired content that measures recompense
words.prose: {{ar:كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:kasabat}}) closes the open basis phrase by supplying what the self acquired. Its perfect form makes acquisition prior to recompense, and its feminine agreement keeps the basis tied to the singular self rather than the later plural group. The {{ar:ك س ب}} ({{tr:k-s-b}}) field spans gain and incurred liability, so the same verb can carry reward and burden; the Form I keeps acquisition broad without foregrounding a reflexive self-seeking form. The parallels in 2:286 and 40:17 make the self-attribution frame recognizable.

topics.headline: perfect feminine attribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earned basis is prior to recompense and grammatically tied to the individual self, not to an anonymous collective.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect feminine active, its subject is controlled by the self phrase, and it takes the relative pronoun as its object.

topics.headline: gain and liability range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one acquisition verb cover both profitable gain and incurred burden, letting recompense answer whatever the self made its own.
topics.reason: The lexical range of the root includes earning, acquisition, gain, and liability, all locally governed by the recompense basis phrase.

topics.headline: Form I broad acquisition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the actual Form I keeps acquisition broad enough for gain and burden without shifting the focus to explicit reflexive self-seeking.
topics.reason: The row's counterfactual reflexive form is useful contrast, but the local form is Form I and should not be made more reflexive than the surface warrants.

topics.headline: relative account completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees judgment become determinate only when the self's acquired content fills the previously open slot.
topics.reason: The earning verb completes the relative clause and supplies the evidence that makes recompense proportionate.

topics.headline: self-attribution parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 2:286 and 40:17, where self, acquisition, and recompense belong to the same accountability frame.
topics.reason: The rows identify recurring self-accounting formulas and same-surah earning contexts that converge here.

words.gloss_range: final connector before the independent pronoun, adding and possibly circumstantially framing the no-wronging assurance
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the completed earning basis into a closing safeguard clause. It can function as coordination and as a circumstantial frame, so non-wronging is both added as assurance and heard as the manner or condition of just settlement. The short pivot resets the cadence before the final negated passive.

topics.headline: final safeguard connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closure is not an afterthought; the connector binds no-wronging to the recompense process itself.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the final pronoun-plus-negated-passive clause after the recompense basis, and the local syntax licenses coordination with circumstantial force.

topics.headline: cadence reset before negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a pause-like pivot from accounting mechanics into protected equity.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows note the transition in tone and rhythm before the closing no-wronging clause.

words.gloss_range: independent plural pronoun foregrounding the protected recipients before the negated passive predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) puts the protected recipients before the negation and predicate. The pronoun gathers the distributive singular selves into a plural group without erasing individual accounting. Its masculine plural class reference widens the final assurance beyond a one-to-one feminine singular continuation, so the ayah ends by naming who is shielded before naming what is excluded.

topics.headline: recipients before negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closure foregrounds the protected party before stating the exclusion of wronging.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun stands before the negated passive predicate and functions as the subject of the final clause.

topics.headline: plural gathering of assessed selves
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees each assessed self gathered into a collectively protected group without losing the distributive basis of recompense.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence links the plural pronoun back to the universal singular self phrase as a distributive plural.

words.gloss_range: negator scoping over the passive imperfect wronging predicate as the final exclusion
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the final pressure exclusion: wronging is not allowed to stand as a predicate over the protected group. Because it negates an imperfect passive, the denial is not limited to one completed act; it covers the process or future relevance of judgment. After the earned-basis phrase, this negation rejects mismeasurement and completes the right-order versus wronging bookend.

topics.headline: negated passive scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause denies wronging as an ongoing or future-relevant predicate, not merely as a single completed incident.
topics.reason: The negator directly scopes over the passive imperfect predicate in the final clause.

topics.headline: anti-mismeasure bookend
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final negation protect the proportion between earned basis and return, answering the earlier established right.
topics.reason: The rows connect the negation to the earned-basis phrase and to the right-order versus wronging bookend.

words.gloss_range: negated passive imperfect plural predicate denying wronging, deprivation, or displacement of due return
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, oppression, deprivation, darkness, and putting out of place; locally the negated opposite of rightful order in recompense
words.prose: {{ar:يُظْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yuẓlamūn}}) is the ayah's final lexical landing: the protected recipients are not wronged. The passive suppresses any hypothetical wronging-agent because the point is recipient immunity, and the imperfect keeps the denial open across judgment's process. The {{ar:ظ ل م}} ({{tr:ẓ-l-m}}) field negates deprivation and displacement of due right, answering the earlier truth basis. Parallels such as 36:54, 21:47, and 23:62 show the same no-wronging formula in precise recompense contexts, while 45:21 turns the wrongdoer field into a guarantee that no return is distorted. The final plural ending gives the closure a rounded sound that lands on the protected group after the ayah has moved from singular self to plural assurance.

topics.headline: passive recipient immunity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the passive centers the protected recipients and denies wronging across the judgment process rather than spotlighting a possible wrongdoer.
topics.reason: The verb is a passive imperfect plural predicate under negation, with no expressed wronging-agent.

topics.headline: wronging as negated opposite
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word deny deprivation or displacement of due right, closing the moral opposition opened by established truth.
topics.reason: The root range includes wronging, deprivation, and displacement, and the local negation sets it against the earlier truth and right basis.

topics.headline: no-wronging recompense formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare 36:54, 21:47, and 23:62, where no-wronging formulas protect precise recompense.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly cite no-wronging parallels with self and deed accounting.

topics.headline: passive justice closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees passive recompense and passive no-wronging join into a justice closure: settlement occurs and no due right is lost.
topics.reason: The local sequence pairs passive recompense with passive no-wronging, and the negation protects the proportional return.

topics.headline: final equity landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah land on protected equity after creation, truth, earning, and recompense have built the mechanism.
topics.reason: The final word closes the ayah, reverses the wrongdoer field from 45:21 into a no-wronging guarantee, and gathers truth, earning, and negated wronging into one moral mechanism.

topics.headline: rounded plural cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the plural ending land on the protected group, reinforcing the move from singular self to plural assurance.
topics.reason: The rows preserve the sound payoff and the injustice-darkness field as part of the final negated predicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose clause joins creation in truth to universal recompense, and the ayah closes by denying injustice.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is measured and fixed to reality; acquired action is then answered by a fitting consequence. Injustice is activated as misplacement, so moral consequence belongs to the world's calibration rather than arriving as an unrelated decree.

activation_trace.role: Measuring before making supplies the design and calibration side of the mechanism.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the non-arbitrary norm to which creation and consequence must fit.
Answering an act with good or bad consequence supplies the conversion from conduct to outcome.
Purposeful acquisition supplies what the self brings into the answering relation.
Putting something outside its proper time or place renders the final denial as exclusion of mismatch.

changed_reading.before: The cosmos was created truly, and people will later be judged.
changed_reading.after: The cosmos is a calibrated moral order whose stated end includes fitting each acquisition to its consequence without displacement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Every self is passively recompensed by what it acquired, with no self omitted and no due withheld.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recompense can be pictured as one thing standing in the place of another. The acquired act therefore yields an answering counterpart that confronts the very self that acquired it; universality closes escape, while the denial of withholding protects what is due.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in another's place supplies the act-to-counterpart relation rather than a detached award.
Encompassing all parts makes the answering relation exceptionless.
The very identity of the thing anchors consequence to the same self rather than to a proxy.
Gain deliberately brought to oneself supplies the material from which the counterpart arises.
Withholding a right makes non-injustice include delivery of the full answering due.

changed_reading.before: A reward or penalty is assigned externally to each person.
changed_reading.after: Each self meets an answering counterpart of its own acquisition, with every self included and nothing due suppressed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah places the self, its acquisition, and its created condition in one causal sentence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation can include inward disposition, and the self can name its intention and discernment. Acquisition may therefore be self-modifying: what is gained is not only an external deed total but an inward orientation that becomes answerable.

activation_trace.role: Inward disposition and ingrained nature supply a created interior capable of being shaped.
Intention and discernment within the self supply the interior locus of accountable orientation.
Acquiring benefit through effort supplies the process by which an orientation can become one's own.
Consequential answering makes the acquired interior, as well as overt conduct, morally live.

changed_reading.before: Only outward deeds are entered into an account.
changed_reading.after: What a self acquires may include the inward orientation it has made its own, so recompense can address a formed self as well as discrete acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence repeatedly treats cosmic, creaturely, and ecological order as visible evidence addressed to certainty and reason. Truth in the focus ayah therefore becomes an inspectable correspondence between created order and moral end, not merely an asserted metaphysical label.

activation_trace.role: Reality-matching stability supplies the focus claim that the created order is genuinely coherent.
A visible mark turns the heavens and earth into evidence and makes the focus order readable.
Knowledge stabilized beyond doubt supplies the epistemic response expected from creaturely signs.
Reason as restraint from ignorance supplies the operation that joins recurring changes into a coherent pattern.

structural_cues: 45:3-5 moves from the heavens and earth, through creaturely creation, to recurring environmental changes, naming each layer evidentiary.
45:6 repeats the focus truth-root in the act of recitation, linking cosmic and verbal disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated visible signs and epistemic responses; I infer that the reality-fit of 45:22 is meant to be inspectable. A live alternative is that the signs establish creator-power while leaving moral fit implicit.

changed_reading.before: Creation in truth means only that the statement about creation is correct.
changed_reading.after: Creation and recompense form a publicly legible pattern, so failure to see their fit can itself be an epistemic distortion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sea and cosmos are driven into human service, humans seek from a gift, and gratitude is the expected response. Acquisition in 45:22 can therefore be read as use of entrusted affordances: recompense evaluates how a given field of possibility was directed, not only isolated acts abstracted from provision.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the focus hinge between available provision and accountable use.
Driving something into service for a purpose supplies the field of usable cosmic affordance.
Active seeking supplies the human response that converts availability into acquisition.
Gift and benefaction keep the acquired good from being treated as self-originating property.
Recognition of benefit and benefactor supplies the norm by which use becomes responsive or unresponsive.

structural_cues: 45:12 sequences service, movement, seeking, gift, and gratitude in one practical chain.
45:13 expands the field from the sea to everything in the heavens and earth before 45:22 returns to those same cosmic poles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies subjected resources, seeking, gift, and gratitude; I add the arrow that entrusted affordance creates accountable response. The live alternative is pure benefaction without an implied audit of use.

changed_reading.before: Earning is a private deed tally carried out inside an otherwise neutral world.
changed_reading.after: Earning is how a self directs gifted cosmic affordances, so recompense audits response to provision as well as the resulting act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recompense-and-acquisition formula in 45:14 is followed by work that is for the same self or against it and then by return. This sharpens the focus passive into a reflexive circuit: intentional action folds back upon its source rather than functioning as a token to which an unrelated sentence is attached.

activation_trace.role: Action answered by consequence supplies the returning output of the circuit.
Self-directed acquisition supplies the circuit's originating input.
The self as the very identity of the agent keeps input and returned outcome attached to one bearer.
Intentional work supplies the concrete conduct that benefits or burdens its doer.
Return to a prior point supplies the closing motion by which action and agent are brought back together.

structural_cues: 45:14 repeats recompense by acquisition immediately before 45:15 states self-benefit, self-burden, and return.
45:15 contrasts benefactive and adverse prepositions around the same self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-benefit, self-burden, and return; I infer a causal fold from action back to agent. A live alternative treats those clauses as legal allocation rather than action's intrinsic return.

changed_reading.before: An authority assigns reward or punishment after observing conduct.
changed_reading.after: Intentional conduct returns upon the same self that originated it, and divine recompense completes that reflexive relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah names wrong acquisition with a root that also cuts or wounds, rejects making differently acting groups equal, and calls such leveling bad judgment. The focus denial of injustice can therefore oppose false equivalence as well as excessive penalty: acquired acts leave differentiating traces that truthful judgment does not erase.

activation_trace.role: Differential answering of action supplies the consequence that preserves morally relevant distinctions.
Misplacing a thing supplies the sense in which undifferentiated treatment can itself be unjust.
Cutting and wounding supply a material trace left by action.
Acquiring an act keeps the wound-image anchored to the actual conduct named in the context.
Equating two things supplies the proposed flattening that the sequence rejects.
Judgment between people locates the rejected equality inside an evaluative decision rather than a mere comparison.

structural_cues: 45:21 is the immediate question to which 45:22 supplies a creation-and-recompense rationale.
The proposed equality spans both life and death, so the rejected flattening is temporal as well as social.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the wound/acquisition bifurcation and rejects equal treatment; I infer that acts leave morally differentiating traces. The live alternative activates only ordinary acquisition and reads the contrast as legal merit without a material trace.

changed_reading.before: Not being wronged means only that no one receives more punishment than deserved.
changed_reading.after: Not being wronged also means that truthful judgment will not erase action-made differences by forcing unlike lives into a false equality.

context_deltas.mechanism: Taking desire as an object of devotion is followed by stamped hearing and heart and covered sight. Together with the focus branches for inward disposition and intention, this activates a self-forming reading: acquisition can include a participated-in perceptual closure, so the recompensed self is partly the sensorium its commitments have helped form.

activation_trace.role: Inward disposition supplies the character layer on which repeated commitment can register.
Intention and discernment within the self supply the interior faculty affected by orientation.
Making a gain one's own supplies the focus route from chosen attachment to acquired condition.
Adoption as acquisition supplies the act by which desire is installed as an authority.
The self's inclination supplies the directional force around which perception becomes organized.
An impressed seal supplies a durable end-state while leaving its full causal history open.
An overlying cover supplies the perceptual closure through which an acquired orientation limits sight.

structural_cues: 45:23 moves from adopted desire to hearing, heart, sight, and failed recollection in one person-centered sequence.
God is the explicit immediate agent of misguidance and sealing, preventing a purely self-caused account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen adoption, inward inclination, sealing, and covering; I infer that commitment participates in forming the perceiver later judged. A materially live alternative is that the closure is wholly a divine consequence rather than an acquired self-condition.

changed_reading.before: The self is a fixed observer whose external acts alone are recompensed.
changed_reading.after: The self may also answer for an acquired orientation that has helped shape how it hears, understands, and sees, though divine agency keeps this reading non-exclusive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim that extended time alone destroys life is marked as conjecture, then answered by divine enlivening, death, and gathering. Creation in truth and for recompense thus resists temporal scatter: lives do not dissolve into an indifferent sequence but remain gatherable toward a moral end.

activation_trace.role: Stable reality supplies the focus alternative to a merely conjectured account of temporal dissolution.
Extended time supplies the rival mechanism that would disperse life without a moral terminus.
Unstable surmise marks the time-only mechanism as epistemically incomplete.
Bringing dispersed parts together supplies the reversal of temporal scattering required for recompense.

structural_cues: 45:24's time-only claim is answered in 45:26 by a life-death-gathering sequence.
45:27 returns immediately to dominion over the same heavens and earth named in the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attribution to time, its conjectural status, and subsequent gathering; I infer that 45:22 denies morally inert temporal closure. The live alternative is a narrower proof of resurrection power with no claim about the texture of time itself.

changed_reading.before: Judgment is simply an event scheduled after ordinary life and death.
changed_reading.after: Truthful creation remains held across death and regathers what time appears to scatter so that moral consequence is not lost to chronology.

context_deltas.mechanism: Communities are called to a written record, that record indicates or speaks against them in truth, and their works are copied. Recompense by acquisition becomes evidentiary self-disclosure: acts are joined into a durable form that can testify rather than merely being remembered by an unshown authority.

activation_trace.role: Answering action with consequence supplies the adjudicative event that the record supports.
Correspondence with reality supplies the truth standard for the archive's testimony.
A summons by speech supplies the transition from gathered community to presented evidence.
Ordered writing supplies the durable record to which each community is called.
Signification that speaks for itself makes the record evidentiary rather than inert.
Transferring a written image into another record supplies preservation across the gap between act and hearing.
Intentional work identifies what is preserved and makes the archive answerable to actual conduct.

structural_cues: 45:28 repeats universality, recompense, and works from the focus ayah before 45:29 introduces the speaking record.
The record speaks against its addressees, giving the sequence an adversarial evidentiary shape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies summons, writing, signifying speech, copying, and work; I infer that acts acquire a durable testimonial form. A live alternative keeps the record wholly external and treats its speech as ordinary divine evidence.

changed_reading.before: An omniscient judge recalls deeds and assigns their outcomes.
changed_reading.after: Works are preserved in a truth-bearing witness that can disclose their fit to recompense, making judgment evidentiary as well as sovereign.

context_deltas.mechanism: On the positive side, righteous work is followed by the Lord causing entry into mercy and naming that success. This weakens a closed wage-equivalence reading of recompense: work remains relevant, but the good outcome can be a divinely granted domain rather than a commodity numerically identical to what was earned.

activation_trace.role: Consequential response supplies the baseline relation that the mercy sequence qualifies.
Acquired conduct remains the human-side condition without fixing the quantitative size of the outcome.
Intentional work preserves a real conduct-to-outcome relation.
Soundness against corruption specifies the kind of work associated with the positive outcome.
Movement into an interior supplies a granted destination rather than a counted payout.
Tender mercy supplies an outcome whose generosity need not be exhausted by wage equivalence.
Attaining good and escape names the successful whole produced by entry into mercy.

structural_cues: 45:30 shifts the acting subject from righteous people to their Lord at the point of entry.
The destination is expressed as being inside mercy, not as receiving a priced object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work followed by divine entry into mercy and success; I infer that mercy can exceed a wage. The live alternative is that mercy simply names the reward already due under exact recompense.

changed_reading.before: Every good outcome is quantitatively identical to the amount earned.
changed_reading.after: Righteous work is genuinely answerable, yet its positive consequence may be entry into a mercy that exceeds closed commercial equivalence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bad works become visible, what was mocked descends and surrounds, prior neglect is answered by present abandonment, and no exit follows. Recompense by what was acquired can therefore be causal and material: the deed is not only evidence used to calculate a separate sentence but becomes the disclosed condition that encloses its doer.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition supplies the material the self has made its own before that material becomes manifest.
Consequential answering supplies the transformation from prior act to present condition.
Emergence into view supplies the disclosure by which hidden moral effects become encountered reality.
Intentional work identifies the appearing content as the agents' own conduct.
A harmful outcome descending and surrounding supplies the conversion of consequence into environment.
The repeated leaving or neglect relation supplies the explicit mirror between prior disregard and present abandonment.
Passage to the outside supplies the denied escape from the condition one's acts now constitute.

structural_cues: 45:33-35 sequences appearance, enclosure, mirrored neglect, and denied exit.
The appearing bad works and the surrounding object are grammatically tied to what the subjects had previously done or mocked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appearance, encirclement, reciprocal neglect, and no exit; I infer that the focus preposition can mark causal or material consequence, not only a scale of payment. A live alternative keeps the outcome externally imposed but keyed to deeds.

changed_reading.before: A deed is used to calculate a separate reward or sentence.
changed_reading.after: A deed can become visible and environmental, surrounding the self as the very condition through which recompense is experienced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates concrete vertical and joint-fitting branches under abstract cosmological language. It remains anchored to the focus heavens, earth, truth, and denial of misplacement, but downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-material analogy for justice, not as a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ayah places elevated heavens, lower earth, truth, recompense, and non-misplacement in one construction.

activation_trace.role: Elevation supplies the upper pole of a vertically articulated order.
The lower counterpart to the sky supplies the order's grounded pole.
A joint or container matching its proper place supplies the concrete image of exact articulation.
Physical misplacement supplies the failure mode that just recompense excludes.

changed_reading.before: Truth and non-injustice are abstract properties of divine action.
changed_reading.after: The cosmos can be imagined as an articulated fit in which each consequence is seated in its proper moral joint rather than forced into the wrong place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because it activates the split cutting target mapped from the focus recompense root and then a cutting branch under the later criminal root. It remains anchored to recompense and acquisition and gains contextual support from later disclosure, but downstream prose should label it a harvest analogy, never an etymological gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus passive recompense is governed by what each self has acquired, allowing an exploratory yield-at-settlement image.

activation_trace.role: Ripeness for cutting supplies a distant harvest-time image for the moment of recompense.
Obtained gain supplies the yield that has accumulated to the self.
Cutting or harvest supplies a second deliberately distant material cue for severing the matured yield.
Emergence into view supplies the reveal in which the harvested yield is finally seen.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an abstract transfer posted to an account.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, acquisition ripens into a yield that is cut and revealed at settlement, so the self encounters the crop of its own activity.

strongest_changes: The immediate wound/acquisition and rejected-equality sequence made non-injustice oppose moral flattening, not only excessive punishment.
The self-benefit, self-burden, and return sequence turned recompense into a reflexive circuit from action back to agent.
The called, speaking, copied record made recompense evidentiary and preservational rather than an invisible act of recall.
The appearance and enclosure of prior works made acquired conduct a possible environment of consequence, while entry into mercy kept the positive side from collapsing into strict wage equivalence.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation was the convergence of measurement, fit and misplacement, wound and acquisition, archival speech, and appearance with enclosure. It generated several causal readings that remain compatible in parts but should not be collapsed into one mechanism.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus preposition can still be heard as measure, cause, instrument, or evidence, and the packet does not force one relation.
Entry into mercy may exceed exact equivalence, or mercy may simply name the recompense already due.
The self-formation reading must preserve divine agency in sealing and cannot make perceptual closure wholly self-produced.
The articulated-fit and harvest readings depend on concrete or split mappings and remain analogical outliers rather than lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Cosmic proportion grounds moral proportion.** `خ ل ق/B001` is measuring before execution, `ح ق ق/B005` makes truth stand, and `ج ز ي/B001` matches recompense to act. The conjunction joins measured creation to measured repayment. The packet supplies that link; I infer that the same non-arbitrary ordering governs physical differentiation and moral consequence. Judgment is thus read as completion of creation's proportioning, not as a later interruption imposed on it.
2. **No grievance remains structurally possible.** `ظ ل م/B003` is grievance and seeking redress. Each self receives what it acquired, and 45:28-29 later supplies community books and a speaking record. I infer that transparent correspondence between act and recompense removes the basis of a valid grievance. "They are not wronged" becomes an evidentiary claim about traceability, not only a declaration of benevolence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The copied, speaking book in 45:29 supplies the traceability that this ayah's denial of grievance presupposes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Measured creation is the architecture that makes matching recompense possible.** Lexical anchors: measuring/proportioning in `خ ل ق B001`, due obligation in `ح ق ق B002`, matching recompense in `ج ز ي B001`, and acquired benefit in `ك س ب B001`. The packet supplies decisive adjudication in 45:17, rejected false equality in 45:21, gathering in 45:26, and dominion in 45:27. I infer calibrated cosmos -> stable due-relations -> act-matched return. "Created in truth" now bears juridical-causal force rather than serving as a general cosmological preface.
2. **No self is placed under a consequence belonging elsewhere.** Lexical anchors: totality in `ك ل ل B003`, the exact thing itself in `ن ف س B012`, and doing something in the wrong concrete place or time in `ظ ل م B004`. The fixed construction pairs every self with what it acquired; the packet supplies the miscalculated equality of 45:21 and gathering without erased distinctions in 45:26. I infer exact self + exact acquisition -> correctly placed result. Negated `يُظْلَمُونَ` becomes precision against displacement: no earning is assigned to the wrong bearer or position.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:26's ordered regathering and 45:27's cohesive dominion turned "created in truth" into executable architecture for settlement. They also strengthened the placement reading of negated `ظ ل م B004`: the system can return each acquired result to its exact bearer.

baseline.text: Allah gökleri ve yeri gerçeğe uygun olarak yarattı; her can kazandığının karşılığını alsın diye. Onlara haksızlık edilmez.

findings.text: Göklerle yerin ölçülü yaratılışı, her eyleme denk karşılığın verilebilmesini sağlayan aynı oranlı düzenin fiziksel mimarisidir.
Haksızlık edilmemesi, hiçbir sonucun yanlış benliğe ya da yanlış yere yüklenmemesi demektir; her kazanım tam olarak kendi taşıyıcısına yerleştirilir.
Yapılanlarla karşılık arasındaki izlenebilir bağ, geçerli bir haksızlık iddiasına dayanak bırakmayacak bir kanıt açıklığı sağlar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Intended action creates an attributable entry that can be claimed, compared, judged, and reciprocally settled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wrongdoing is both acquisition and incision, equality is a disputed valuation, and the self is the legal identity to which the resulting account returns.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Personal Account Returns to Its Owner
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Deliberate work is acquired by a self, creates an obligation, and returns through reciprocal settlement without withheld right.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: the self as identical bearer (`quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`); intended action (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`); earned acquisition (`quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`); reciprocal recompense (`quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`); return to an originating state or owner (`quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`); fixed obligation (`quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`); withholding a due right (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The self is not a generic person but the persistent identity that owns an act across time. Earning attaches the entry, obligation fixes it, return restores it to its bearer, and recompense settles it without detention of what is due.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Intended action creates an attributable entry that can be claimed, compared, judged, and reciprocally settled.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Contested Proof Awaits a Cutting Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Clear evidence enters a dispute, speakers advance a purported proof and truth claim, and a final judgment separates valid assertion from performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: disclosed evidence (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); prevailing proof in dispute (`quranic:root_000295:B003/m01`); truthful assertion (`quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`); fulfillment that verifies a claim (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); articulated statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); decisive judgment (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); truth fixed to reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The demand to produce the fathers is a courtroom maneuver: statement claims the status of proof, while truth requires enacted verification. The earlier decisive judgment supplies the terminal operation that the argument itself cannot perform.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life persists through generation, vital embodiment, and regathering despite the claim that time merely extinguishes successive bodies.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The resurrection dispute is pressured by a full generative chain of lineage, womb, childbirth, parenthood, loss, arrival, and collection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Womb, Lineage, and Fathers Form a Generative Chain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Lineage is built through a womb, childbirth, paternal nurture, arrival, and loss; the demand for the fathers points back into this material chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sons and transmitted lineage (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); womb as the child's enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); childbirth and the newborn (`quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`); fatherhood and nurture (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`); arrival into presence (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); bringing or presenting another (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); a parent's loss of a child (`quranic:root_001454:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lexical field renders ancestry as embodied production rather than an inert list of predecessors. Asking that fathers be brought back invokes arrival at the far end of a process whose earlier stages already include enclosing, birthing, nurturing, and bereavement.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, nesnenin kesilmesi ya da işlenmesi öncesinde ölçülmesini ve sınırlarının uygun biçimde belirlenmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Deri örneği bu işlemi somutlaştırır; yoktan var etme ve yalan uydurma anlamları bu dalın parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, eylemden önceki ölçme ve sınır belirleme aşamasıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ölçme ve biçme anlamını karşılar; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış kullanımlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesneyi kesme ya da uygulama öncesinde ölçüp sınırlarını uygun ve düzgün biçimde belirlemektir.

facets.statement: Nesnenin ölçüsü ve sınırları yapılacak işten önce belirlenir.
Bir deri parçasını kesmeden önce tuluma göre ölçmek bu işlemin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı ölçme, oranlama ve kesmeden önce sınır koyma çevresinde birleştirir; düzgün ve uygun ölçü vurgusu da bu çekirdeği tamamlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yapılacak işe göre önceden ölçülüp biçildiği genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ön ölçme ve sınır belirleme işlemlerinin ikisini de korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri, kumaş veya benzeri bir nesnenin kesime hazırlanmasını anlatan bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölçmenin eylemden önce geldiğini ve kesime yöneldiğini korur.
Önceden bir değer belirleme düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesneyi ölçme ve uygulama sınırlarını belirleme işlemlerini kaybeder.
error_profile.collision: Belirsiz bir kestirimle ölçüye dayalı hazırlığı birbirine karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ölçüyü kesme ya da yapma öncesinde nesnenin kendi sınırları için belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi başka bir örneğe göre karşılaştırarak ölçme ilişkisini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ön ölçme ile örneğe göre ölçme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin ölçüsünü ve uygun büyüklüğünü belirleme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda başka bir örneğe dayanmak zorunlu değildir; komşu dalda ise ölçme, bir örnekle karşılaştırma üzerine kuruludur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yapılacak nesnenin ölçü ve sınırlarını eylemden önce belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesneyi gerçekten ortaya çıkarma ve var etme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ölçülü hazırlık ile ortaya çıkarma aynı üretim sürecinin bağlantılı aşamaları olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal hazırlık ve ölçülendirmede kalır; komşu dal sonucunda bir varlık ya da yapılmış şey ortaya çıkar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnızca ölçmeye dayalı en yakın karşılaştırma ile aynı kökün var etme dalı sınırı belirginleştirdiği için seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التقدير والقياس قبل القطع أو الفعل، ومنه خلق الأديم وخلق الأمر بمعنى قدره.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه إبداع الله للخلق من غير أصل، ولا اختلاق الكذب إلا من جهة أنه قدر في النفس.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أحدهما تقدير الشيء؛ خلقت الأديم للسقاء إذا قدرته (maqayis)؛ خلقت الأديم قدرته (ayn)؛ خلقت الشيء إذا قدرته (jamhara)؛ الخلق: التقدير؛ خلقت الأديم إذا قدرته قبل القطع (sihah)؛ الخلق في كلام العرب على ضربين... والآخر التقدير؛ خلقت الأديم إذا قدرته وقسته (tahdhib)؛ الخلق أصله: التقدير المستقيم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı bir şeyi ortaya çıkarma ve var etme çekirdeğinde birleşir, fakat bunu hem öncesiz bir örnek olmadan meydana getirme hem de bir şeyden başka bir şey oluşturma biçiminde kullanır. Üretici adı ile yaratılanlar topluluğu da eylemden türeyen ayrı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım, var etmenin iki kapsamını korur; üreticiyi ve yaratılanları adlandıran kullanımları çekirdekle birleştirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal, ortaya çıkarma eylemini tanımlar; adlaşmış üretici ve yaratılanlar anlamları bağımlı uzantılar olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi daha önce örneği olmadan ortaya koymak ya da başka bir şeyden yeni bir varlık meydana getirmektir. Eylem, onu yapanı ve sonuçta ortaya çıkan varlıkları adlandıran kullanımlara da uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir şey ortaya çıkarılır ve varlık kazanır.
Ortaya çıkarma, öncesiz bir örnek olmadan veya mevcut bir şeyden gerçekleştirilebilir.
Eylemi yapan üretici ile ortaya çıkan varlıklar eylem adından türeyen biçimlerle adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak noktası ortaya çıkarma ve var etmedir; anlatım örneksiz başlangıcı, bir şeyden başka bir şey oluşturmayı, üreticiyi ve yaratılanlar topluluğunu birlikte kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin meydana getirilmesini, özellikle de başlangıç verilmeyen veya köklü bir var etme eylemini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Ortaya çıkarma ve varlık kazandırma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyi varlığa getiren üstün ve köklü meydana getirme eylemi için doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi ortaya çıkarma ve varlık kazandırma anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin sonucunda var olanların topluca adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemin sonucunu oluşturan varlıklar topluluğunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yaratan, var eden; özellikle Tanrı için kullanılan ad
yaratılmış varlık ya da varlıklar topluluğu

error_profile.preserves: Bir sonuç meydana getirme düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Örneksiz var etme kapsamını ve bütün varlıkları ortaya çıkarma gücünü kaybeder.
error_profile.collision: Gündelik yapım ve çoğaltma işleriyle köklü var etme eylemini karıştırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Var etmeyi hem örneksiz başlangıç hem de bir şeyden başka bir şey oluşturma olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Örneksiz başlatmayı, yeniliği ve kendi alanında ilk olmayı özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da daha önce bulunmayan bir şeyi ortaya çıkarma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın ayırıcı koşulu önceki örneğin bulunmamasıdır; bu dal ise mevcut bir şeyden yeni bir şey oluşturmayı da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Var etmenin yanında üreticiyi ve yaratılanlar topluluğunu adlandıran uzantılar taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ortaya çıkarmaya ek olarak büyütme ve gelişimi sürdürme boyutunu içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeğinde bir şeyi ortaya çıkarıp varlık kazandırma vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yaratma eylemine odaklanır; komşu dal bazı kullanımlarda meydana getirmeyi gelişim ve yetiştirmeyle birlikte düşünür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eylemin sonunda gerçek bir varlık ya da yapılmış şey ortaya çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesnenin ölçüsünü ve sınırlarını eylem öncesinde belirlemekle yetinir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ölçülü tasarım, bir şeyi meydana getirme sürecinden önce gelebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sonuç doğuran var etmedir; komşu dal yalnızca ölçü ve tasarı sınırlarını kurar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; örneksiz başlatma, oluşturup geliştirme ve aynı kökün ön ölçme dalı gerçek sınır farkları verdi, kalanlar daha uzak alan bağlantıları olarak elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خلق الله الخلق، والخالق الصانع، وإبداع الشيء أو إيجاده من شيء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد التقدير الحرفي، ولا الخلق بمعنى السجية أو الكذب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الخالق الصانع (ayn)؛ الخلق مصدر خلق الله الخلق يخلقهم خلقا (jamhara)؛ هم خليقة الله (sihah)؛ الخالق والخلاق؛ الخلق ابتداع الشيء على مثال لم يسبق إليه (tahdhib)؛ يستعمل في إبداع الشيء من غير أصل ولا احتذاء؛ ويستعمل في إيجاد الشيء من الشيء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı dıştan görülen biçimin tamamlanması, dengeli oluşu ve görünür duruma gelmesi üzerinde birleşir. Genel bir güzellik yargısı zorunlu değildir; asıl ölçüt oluşumun tamamlanması ve biçimin gözle seçilebilmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal görünür beden ve biçimle sınırlıdır; iç huyu veya yalnızca güzel görünmeyi tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal dış görünüşün oluşmuş ve dengeli olmasını anlatır; iç karakter veya başka kalıpların anlamları eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın dıştan görülebilen biçiminin tamamlanmış, dengeli ve belirgin hale gelmiş olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Dış biçim tamamlanmış ve gözle seçilebilir durumdadır.
İnsan bedeninde tamamlık ve ölçülü görünüş özellikle vurgulanır.
Gelişmekte olan beden taslağının biçiminin belirmesi de bu tamamlanma ekseninde anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar görünür şekil, beden yapısının tamamlanması ve parçaların dengeli biçimde belirmesi üzerinde birleşir; oluşumu henüz görünür olmayan durum bunun karşısında yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bedenin veya nesnenin görünür yapısının tamamlanmış ve ölçülü olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görünürlük, tamamlanma ve dengeli biçim özelliklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Oluşum sürecindeki bir bedenin ya da parçanın görünür yapısının belirdiği bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Biçimin oluşmasını ve tamamlanmasını açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Dengeli ve ölçülü görünüş vurgusunu açıkça söylemez.

error_profile.preserves: Dış görünüşe ilişkin bir değerlendirme alanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Biçimin tamamlanması ve parçaların dengeli oluşu koşullarını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Olumlu beğeni ve çekicilik yargısı ekler.
error_profile.collision: Tam oluşmuş bir biçimi beğenilen bir görünüşle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dış biçimin oluşumca tamamlanmış ve ölçülü olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boy, beden, yüz veya genel görünüşü tamamlanma koşulu aramadan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanın gözle algılanan bedeni ve görünüşüyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal oluşumun tamamlığına hükmeder; komşu dal görünür yapıyı veya boyu yalnızca betimler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gözle algılanan dış biçim ve beden yapısını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İçten taşınan huyu ve insanlarla davranış biçimini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insanın nasıl bir yapıya sahip olduğunu farklı yönlerden anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada yapı bedensel ve görünürdür; komşu dalda ise davranışta beliren iç eğilimdir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar gözden geçirildi; görünür yapı ile genel görünüş arasındaki fark ve aynı kökün iç karakter dalıyla karşıt alan sınırı okuyucu için en yararlı iki ayrım oldu.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تمام الخلق، اعتدال الصورة، ظهور التصوير، والهيئات والأشكال المدركة بالبصر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه السجية الباطنة ولا النصيب ولا البلى.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل مختلق تام الخلق؛ المختلق من كل شيء ما اعتدل (maqayis)؛ رجل خليق أي تم خلقه؛ المختلق من كل شيء ما اعتدل (ayn)؛ رجل خليق ومختلق أي تام الخلق معتدل؛ مضغة مخلقة أي تامة الخلق (sihah)؛ رجل خليق إذا تم خلقه؛ مخلقة قد بدا خلقها وغير مخلقة لم تصور (tahdhib)؛ خص الخلق بالهيئات والأشكال والصور المدركة بالبصر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımının çekirdeği kişinin içten taşıdığı huy ve kalıcı eğilimdir. İyi geçinme, erdemli davranış, yaşam yolu ve bir huyu sonradan edinmeye çalışma aynı çekirdeğin davranışsal veya kazanılmış uzantılarıdır; bunlar doğuştan yapıyla özdeş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İç eğilim çekirdektir; iyi geçinme ve edinilmiş tutumlar bağımlı kullanımlar olarak ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler iç huyu anlatır; iyi huyluluk, insanlarla geçinme ve bir huy edinme gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlar ayrıca sınırlandırılır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin içten taşıdığı ve davranışlarında dışa vurduğu kalıcı eğilim ve huydur. İyi geçinme, erdemli tutum, yaşam yolu ve bir huyu edinmeye çalışma bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Kişinin iç dünyasında yerleşmiş bir huy ve davranış eğilimi bulunur.
Bu iç eğilim erdemli yaşayış, insanlarla iyi geçinme ve benimsenen yaşam yolu olarak görünür.
Kişi kendisinde olmayan bir huyu çabayla edinmeye veya öyle görünmeye çalışabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar iç huy, doğuştan ya da yerleşik eğilim ve bunun insan ilişkilerindeki görünümü çevresinde birleşir; erdemli yaşayış ile sonradan huy edinme bu alanın uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin davranışlarını yönlendiren yerleşik iç eğilimi genel olarak anlatmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yerleşik huyu ve davranışta beliren iç yapıyı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin insanlarla olumlu, ölçülü ve iyi bir biçimde ilişki kurmasını anlatan yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İç huyun insan ilişkilerindeki olumlu görünümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Olumsuz veya değerce yansız huyları ve genel iç yapı kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğal olmayan bir davranış biçiminin çabayla benimsenmesini veya öyle görünmeye çalışılmasını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Sonradan huy edinme çabasını ve doğal huydan ayrımını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir huyu edinmeye veya öyle görünmeye çalışmak

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kalıcı iç özellikleri düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Huyun davranış ve geçinme biçiminde dışa vurulmasını açıkça göstermez.
error_profile.adds: Benlik, bireysel özellikler ve toplumsal kimlik gibi daha geniş alanlar ekler.
error_profile.collision: Huy alanını kişinin bütün ruhsal ve toplumsal özellikleriyle karıştırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İç huyun insanlarla geçinme, erdemli yaşayış ve sonradan edinilme uzantılarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişiye yerleşmiş ve onu sürekli izleyen doğal eğilimi özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: davranışta beliren huy ile sabit eğilim
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişide süreklilik gösteren iç huy ve eğilimi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal daha çok değişmez ve yerleşik doğaya yönelir; bu dal huyun ilişkilerdeki görünümünü ve edinilme çabasını da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İyi geçinme ve sonradan bir huy edinme gibi davranışsal uzantılara açıktır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsanın ya da canlının başlangıçtan beri taşıdığı doğuştan yapıyı vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanın içten gelen ve davranışını etkileyen yapısını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yerleşik veya kazanılmış huyu kapsar; komşu dalın ayırıcı yönü doğuştan verilmiş yapıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İç eğilim ve davranış biçimini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gözle görülen beden biçiminin tamamlık ve dengesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişide bulunan bir yapıyı farklı algı yollarıyla ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal davranıştan anlaşılan iç yapıdır; komşu dal gözle görülen dış yapıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sabit doğal eğilim, doğuştan yapı ve aynı kökün dış biçim dalı bu geniş iç-huy alanının sınırlarını en açık biçimde gösterdi.
